title: Delivery Output manifest
description: Provenance manifest sidecar written beside every exported Delivery Output, named <media-basename>.output.json (e.g. my-video-final.mp4 -> my-video-final.output.json). One sidecar per media file; multiple Delivery Outputs may share a flat directory. Contract-strict: schema validity is intended to prove the full VP-6 Delivery Output contract, including exact approved-parent render identity, canonical Final Render Plan identity, operative Approval binding, immutable upstream editorial Approval lineage, render-specific QA, export mode, and resolved destination. A hash-different creative render requires fresh Final Render Approval. A separately provenanced and QA'd bitrate/codec-only Mechanical Derivative may instead rely on its approved parent. Target contract (unenforced): until the stack generates this, agents/humans write it manually per docs/processes/VP-6-promote-retire.md.
$comment: Draft-07 cannot compare sibling fields or inspect media. The exporter MUST assert the equality/difference and actual media-invariant obligations defined in VP-6, including Approval-to-source identity binding, byte-identical copy hash equality, mechanical-transcode hash difference and invariant comparison, mechanical parent binding, and destination.resolvedPath containing media.file.

name.description: Human-readable output name, usually the media basename

exportMode.description: Whether media is the approved render's exact bytes or the narrowly permitted bitrate/codec-only derivative

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail filename relative to this manifest, when exported

runPath.description: Absolute path of the run at export time

renderPath.description: Run-relative path of the exactly approved render; for a mechanical transcode, this is the approved parent

renderSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exactly approved render; equals media.sha256 only for byte-identical-copy — asserted by the exporter, see $comment

sourceSha256.description: Hash of the original source media, for lineage

planRevision.description: Identifier or hash of the exact compiled editorial plan behind the approved render

id.description: Canonical Final Render Plan/recipe revision identifier

sha256.description: Canonical hash of that exact final render-plan/recipe

ref.description: Run-relative reference to the canonical final render-plan/recipe

scope.description: Precise machine scope of the operative Approval. final-render denotes Final Render Approval for one exact hash-identified creative final and its Final Render Plan after render-specific QA; earlier editorial Approvals remain in editorialApprovalLineage

decisionRef.description: Where the operative Approval decision is recorded (review note, story README, message)

renderSha256.description: Exact render SHA-256 accepted by the operative Approval; exporter asserts equality with source.renderSha256

finalRenderPlanSha256.description: Canonical Final Render Plan hash accepted by the operative Approval; exporter asserts equality with source.finalRenderPlan.sha256

editorialApprovalLineage.description: Immutable upstream editorial Approval lineage: exactly one complete Baseline Approval first, followed only when applicable by one complete Sequence Optimization Approval. Later Final Render Approval never rewrites these decisions.

transcriptComparisonRef.description: Optional: not every video contains speech

qaRefs.description: Run-relative references to render-specific evidence that verified the exactly approved render

parentRenderSha256.description: Approved parent hash; exporter asserts equality with source.renderSha256 and approval.renderSha256

parentApprovalDecisionRef.description: Operative parent Approval reference; exporter asserts equality with approval.decisionRef

parentFinalRenderPlanSha256.description: Approved parent's Final Render Plan hash; exporter asserts equality with source and Approval plan hashes

recipeRef.description: Reference to the exact mechanical transcode recipe/command

recipeSha256.description: Canonical hash of the exact mechanical transcode recipe

changedFields.description: The only permitted changes from the approved parent

qaRefs.description: References to separately recorded mechanical-derivative QA and parent/output comparison evidence

routing.description: Whether this destination is the ownership default or a human override

resolvedPath.description: Absolute path of the destination directory holding the media and this sidecar at export time

reason.description: Required when routing is override: why this deliverable lives somewhere other than the default

storyTopic.description: Topic folder path; required for story-owned exports
